summary: Full backend and frontend testing of EMERGENT Diagnostic Hub. All 8 backend tests pass. Frontend funnel tested end-to-end: Hero → UserForm → Quiz → (analyzing via API) → Report → Roadmap → HighTicketClose. AI Coach integration working.

integration_issues.issue: Browser automation timed out before completing all 50 questions (stopped at Q17/50 in one session). Quiz correctly advances through questions but the automation tool's default timeout limits full 50-question testing. Manual testing or longer session needed. Functionally the API works correctly.

issues: 6 role options found, requirement mentions 5 - verify if this is intended (Gründer/CEO, C-Level Executive, Senior Manager, Investor, High-Potential, plus one more)

critical_code_review_comments: Report page reads from localStorage only - direct URL navigation to /report without localStorage data shows blank page (by design, but worth documenting for UX)
No route for /report/:session_id - data flow is purely through localStorage state which means refreshing report page requires going back through quiz flow
AI Coach panel correctly persists across /report, /roadmap, /close pages

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all key pages load and work, analyzing page transition not directly verified via automation)
